kpis.name: Kreditvolumen
kpis.desc: Ausstehende Kredite an Firmenkunden per Monatsende.

en.name: Loan volume
en.desc: Outstanding loans to corporate clients at month end.

kpis.name: Neugeschäft
kpis.desc: Neu ausbezahlte Kredite im Monat, über alle Segmente.

en.name: New business
en.desc: Loans newly paid out in the month, across all segments.

en.name: Corporate deposits
en.desc: Amounts due to corporate clients at month end.

kpis.name: Kreditmarge
kpis.desc: Durchschnittliche Marge des Kreditbuchs über dem Refinanzierungssatz.

en.name: Loan margin
en.desc: Average margin of the loan book over the funding rate.

kpis.name: Ausfallquote
kpis.desc: Notleidende Kredite in Prozent des Kreditvolumens.

en.name: Default rate
en.desc: Non-performing loans as a percentage of the loan volume.

kpis.name: Limitenauslastung
kpis.desc: Beanspruchte Kreditlimiten in Prozent der zugesagten. Steigt sie rasch, brauchen Kunden Liquidität.

en.name: Limit utilisation
en.desc: Credit limits drawn as a percentage of those committed. When it rises fast, clients need liquidity.

kpis.name: Wertberichtigungen
kpis.desc: Bestand an Wertberichtigungen für Ausfallrisiken per Monatsende.

en.name: Value adjustments
en.desc: Stock of value adjustments for default risks at month end.
